item.title: WYXR's Stereo Session featuring KWICK's "To The Point" — Memphis Listening Lab
item.description: Wednesday, September 9, 2026 | Memphis Listening Lab | 6 PM | WYXR Presents
item.content:encoded:
📻 WYXR Presents

WYXR's Stereo Session featuring KWICK's "To The Point"

Memphis Listening Lab

Wednesday, September 9, 2026

Time: 6 PM

Released in 1981 on EMI America, To The Point finds KWICK operating in the fertile but competitive aftermath of Stax Records’ collapse, when Memphis funk bands were recalibrating for a new era. Emerging from the Stax-affiliated vocal group the Newcomers, KWICK fused deep harmony traditions with sleek synthesizers, dance-floor precision, and forward-leaning studio polish. Under the guidance of producer and executive Allen Jones—architect of the Bar-Kays’ reinvention—KWICK was part of a wave of self-contained Memphis groups vying for position just beneath the city’s reigning funk institution. Alongside contemporaries like Ebonee Webb, Kilo, Galaxy, and The Main Attraction, KWICK helped define a post-Stax sound that embraced disco’s momentum without abandoning Memphis’s muscular groove. To The Point captures that moment with clarity and confidence—a record shaped by ambition, adaptation, and the enduring belief that Memphis funk still had places to go.

item.title: Larry Heard "On My Way" Book Signing — Memphis Listening Lab
item.description: Saturday, September 19, 2026 | Memphis Listening Lab | 4 PM | WYXR Presents
item.content:encoded:
📻 WYXR Presents

Larry Heard "On My Way" Book Signing

Memphis Listening Lab

Saturday, September 19, 2026

Time: 4 PM

Larry Heard and Ross Devlin invite you to celebrate the release of their new book, "On My Way", at the Memphis Listening Lab. “For 40 years, Larry Heard traveled the world, performing his special blend of soulful Deep House music. From Fingers Inc to Mr. Fingers and beyond, these moments are captured in “On My Way”, a 365-page book that documents this incredible journey through Larry’s eyes. Working with fellow Memphian Ross Devlin, “On My Way” is a singular history of House Music and the people who made it happen. Join us at the Memphis Listening Lab on September 19th, from 4-7pm, as Larry and Ross present this new book for the first time in public. The two will discuss the book along with music historian and WYXR program manager Jared "Jay B." Boyd. Please RSVP to secure your place, as seating will be limited.
